title: Ode to Cookbooks
slide_intent: Identify a visual heritage that communicates care, because familiar forms of food publishing can make a new identity feel grounded.
strategic_value: Annotated historical references can connect Sweetgreen’s contemporary offer to the craft of growing and preparing food.
demonstration: A 1922 seed catalogue and Moosewood Cookbook cover sit side by side with orange circles, arrows and handwritten notes.
practical_value: Trace a proposed illustration or typography direction to specific reference details rather than copying an entire period style.

content_islands.name: Seed catalogue
content_islands.spec: Place the seed catalogue on the left, retaining its typography, field photograph and circled word.

content_islands.name: Cookbook
content_islands.spec: Place the illustrated cookbook on the right, with the produce drawing circled and handwritten annotations intact.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Ode to Cookbooks caption links vintage food illustration to comfort, care and lasting quality.
reference_purposes.Expression: Orange annotations select typography and produce imagery from two historic printed references.
